claim: Hashim Djojohadikusumo (Ketua Dewan Penasihat Kadin) said at Rapimnas Kadin (29 Oct) that Shopee, Lazada, GoTo and banks/fintechs must start collecting digital tax from 9 Nov 2026

DJP (Inge Diana Rismawanti, Direktur P2Humas, written statement 2 Nov): the SPP-TDLN digital tax collection is not a new tax, does not change the PPN rate, and personal transfers/remittances are not its target
DJP has not confirmed the 9 Nov start date (as of its 2 Nov statement)

Separate, earlier statement: DJP head Bimo Wijayanto estimated on 15 Oct that digital-economy tax revenue could rise ~50% to ~Rp16 T (from Rp8-12 T). NOT used in script or captions; listed so it is not reintroduced without its own attribution

Direction of Perlinsos Digital: aid as cash instead of goods (said as 'arahnya'); cash-to-account transfers due for a trial in Q1 2027, data integration to end-2026; eligibility based on DTSEN desil 1-5
Target 50 juta penerima (people), per Katadata/Menkomdigi Meutya Hafid
note: 50 juta = people (Luhut, Meutya). Do not mix with 48 juta keluarga (2027 plan) or 11,5 juta KK registered.
